exposure: duration of second stage of labor
Prolonged second stage of labor (12 hours or more)
Duration of the second stage of labor (2-6 hours, 6-12 hours, 12 hours or longer)
cohort: 446 nulliparous pregnant women with 37 + 0 to 41 + 6 weeks of gestation whom vaginal delivery was attempted at the Yokohama City University Medical Center between 2014 and 2018
finding: While an extremely prolonged second stage of labor was associated with a significant increase in maternal complications such as severe perineal lacerations and chorioamnionitis, there was no significant increase in adverse outcomes for neonates.
